title: Seagrove Beach "Crystal Gulf View" 561 Eastern Lake Road #304
h1: Seagrove Beach "Crystal Gulf View" 561 Eastern Lake Road #304
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gulf views- Walking distance to the beach w/ private beach access- Community pool- 2 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Get swept away with beachside bliss at Crystal Gulf View, an aptly named condo tucked along the shore of Seagrove Beach. Comfortably accommodating 6 guests between 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this lovely retreat is perfect for small groups or families discovering the tranquility of iconic 30A. Enjoy sun-soaked days lounging on the sugar-soft beach, paddleboarding over Eastern Lake, or savoring the enchanting view from the Gulf-front balcony. With a community pool, barbecue area, and dedicated beach access, this home has everything guests need for a sun-filled coastal escape.Open and bright, this single-story condo sets the scene for beach fun with a tile floor for easily sweeping up sand and a back wall of windows framing the resplendent Gulf’s turquoise waters. The kitchen is equipped with high-end appliances for whipping up everything from pancakes to scallops and features a breakfast bar for 4, where guests can indulge in slow-paced mornings savoring a cup of coffee. For sit-down meals, the dining table to the side seats 6. In the living space, a sectional and 2 velvet barrel armchairs offer comfy seating, and plenty of room for the group to gather for movie nights. Wander out the sliding glass door to admire the rolling waves from the high-top chairs. Down the hall, discover the gorgeous primary bedroom with a slider to the Gulf-facing balcony. Families, kids, or social guests will enjoy the cheerful bunk room, featuring a twin-over-queen bunk and a twin bed. For extended stays, a stacked washer and dryer in the bathroom adds convenience.Let Crystal Gulf View’s unbeatable views and exceptional amenities host an amazing Seagrove Beach getaway. Enjoy convenient on-site parking and 2 complimentary adult bikes for leisurely exploration on the Timpoochee Trail. The community’s dedicated beach access is located directly behind the building, or guests can stroll down to the public Ramsgate Beach Access, situated off Eastern Lake Road. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 6):FIRST FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower-Guest Bedroom: Twin over Queen Bunk Bed, Twin Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo*Guests who are 25 years of age or younger must be accompanied by a responsible parent or guardian in any vacation rental managed by Callista by 360 Blue. We do not rent homes to those 25 years of age or younger who are unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian. Moreover, there must be a ratio of at least (1) parent or guardian over the age of 25 for every four (4) young adults who are 25 years of age or younger.
